instructions: Write your full name, roll number, and school name in English on the answer booklet.
Write all your answers in the answer booklet. Answers on the question paper will not be marked.
Write legibly in dark blue pen only.
Answer all questions as provided in the question paper.
Adhere to examination regulations and allowed time.

questions.text: A person is complaining of short sightedness. Explain the best possible correction method that can be used for this problem.
Explain why is it difficult to cure the third stage of syphilis?
Discuss the significance of meiosis.
Describe the role of placenta during pregnancy to foetus.
If a girl started ovulation at the age of 14 and continued until the age of 49, calculate the number of eggs she produced during this.
questions.calculation_steps: Duration = 49 - 14 = 35 years. Eggs per year = 12. Total eggs = 35 * 12 = 420 eggs.
